notes.title: Minimal theme has been released!
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0 is out with a fully featured new theme: Minimal!

http://www.48hstudio.com/img/avoid_minimal_small.jpg

Like the previous ones the new theme contains:

its own graphical style and soundtrack
32 levels with achievements
an endless mode with leaderboards
new obstacles and powerups


Other changes and additions in version 1.1.0:

added mouse controls for the ship: left/right buttons to move, third button to pause the game
improved some sound effects
the “more games” link now goes to a different page
